app.mode_demo: Demo mode (data stays in this browser)

nav.author: Author courses
auth.demo_help: Choose a persona to explore the platform. Everything is synthetic and stays in this browser.
auth.mfa_help: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfa_setup_help: Administrators must use an authenticator app (e.g. FreeOTP, Aegis, Google Authenticator). Scan the QR code, then enter the code it shows.
auth.recovery_help: Each code works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now — store them somewhere safe.
auth.must_change_help: Your password was set by an administrator. Please choose your own before continuing.
auth.pw_rules: At least 10 characters, with letters and a number or symbol. Common passwords are refused.
auth.pw_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
account.demo_note: Password and two-step verification apply to server deployments. In demo mode you sign in with a persona.
account.privacy_text: Your personal data belongs to your Member State. You can download your own records at any time in an open format.
home.exam_ready: You are ready for the final exam
home.locked: Complete all 21 modules to unlock the exam ({n} to go)
learn.library_empty: No shared courses yet. Courses published by Member States and the continental library appear here.
course.outcomes: What you will be able to do
course.finish_first: Finish all lessons first to unlock the quiz.
act.title: Activity
act.order_hint: Put the steps in the right order.
quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.intro: {n} questions. Pass mark {p}%. Three failed attempts lock the module until a trainer unlocks it.
exam.rule_c: Earns {n} CEU and the accredited certificate
exam.not_eligible: Complete {n} more module(s) to unlock the exam.
exam.online_only: The exam needs a connection. Please go online.
ceu.policy: Renewal: {n} CEU every {y} years. External learning can be claimed and is added after approval by your Member State administrator.
ceu.claim_hint: Describe the course or event and attach a link or reference. An administrator will review it.
cert.none: No certificates yet. Complete a level or the final exam to earn one.
cert.awarded: is awarded this certificate for completing the programme
cert.qr: QR code to verify this certificate
cert.scan: Scan the QR code or enter the code at the verification page to confirm this certificate is genuine.
verify.title: Verify a certificate
verify.intro: Enter the certificate code (ACDC-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) or scan its QR code.
verify.unknown_msg: No certificate with this code exists. Check the code and try again.
verify.privacy: Only a masked name is shown to protect the holder's privacy.
offline.intro: Download courses to this device to learn without a connection. Your progress syncs when you are back online.
offline.need_package: Download this course first to use it offline.
offline.note: Quizzes taken offline are queued and marked when you reconnect.
offline.banner: You are offline — only downloaded courses are available.
dash.rank_note: Index = average of enrolment rate (enrolled ÷ registered) and utilization (active in the last 30 days ÷ enrolled). Sort by any column.
dash.not_started_n: {n} Member States have not started yet and are not ranked.
dash.suppress_note: Groups with fewer than 5 people are shown as “<5” to protect privacy.
map.title: Member State coverage
map.note: Tile map: one tile per Member State. Darker means higher. Grey tiles have not started.
map.facility_note: Each dot is a facility positioned by its GPS coordinates.
users.import_help: Upload or paste a CSV with these columns. Temporary passwords are generated for each new user.
users.temp_pw_note: Share it securely. The user must choose a new password at first sign-in.
coh.enrol: Enrol the cohort in a course (optional)
coh.unlock_help: Reset the failed-attempt lock so the learner can try again.
ten.intro: Each Member State has an isolated space. Provision a space, assign its first administrator and move it through pilot to live.
audit.chain_ok: All {n} entries verified — the hash chain is intact.
audit.chain_note: Each entry contains the hash of the previous one; any edit or deletion breaks the chain.
audit.xapi_note: Learning activity is recorded as xAPI statements and can be forwarded to any Learning Record Store.
exp.intro: Your data is yours. Export everything in open formats at any time — no lock-in.
exp.json_help: Users, facilities, enrolments, CEU ledger, certificates and courses.
exp.scorm_help: Export a module as a SCORM 1.2 package for any compatible LMS.
author.intro: Create courses, adapt starter modules to your context, and move them through review before publishing.
author.adapt_help: Copy an existing course into your space and edit it. The original is not changed.
author.question: Question
author.quiz_help: Each question has one correct answer and exactly two wrong answers. At least 3 questions are required.
author.title: Title
author.md_hint: Use **bold**, `code` and “- ” bullet lists. Leave French empty to fall back to English.
author.ceu_note: Final CEU value is set by the reviewer.
author.confirm_unpublish: Unpublish this course? Sharing is removed.
author.locked: Only drafts can be edited. Create a new version to change a published course.
author.four_eyes: You wrote this course, so another administrator must review it (four-eyes rule).
author.sharing_help: Published courses are private to your Member State by default. Share with named partners or submit to the Africa CDC continental library.
check.competency: Aligned with a competency and learning outcome
check.accuracy: Content is technically accurate and current
check.accessibility: Accessible: plain language, alt text, works on low bandwidth

err.finish_lessons_first: Read all lessons before taking the quiz.

err.cannot_disable_self: You cannot disable your own account.
